auth.title: Log in to KaamSathi
auth.subtitle: Enter your mobile number. We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS.
auth.enter_full_code: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
auth.terms: By continuing you agree to KaamSathi's terms of service and privacy policy. Standard SMS rates may apply.
auth.choose_body: Your account has access to both workspaces. Where would you like to go?
auth.choose_app: Hire, take hajiri and run payroll for your organization.
auth.choose_ops: Verify workers, match candidates and monitor open jobs.
auth.panel_title: Hiring, hajiri and talab — in one place.
auth.panel_body: Built for Nepal's hotels, hospitals, security agencies, factories and construction sites.
auth.point_verified_body: Citizenship/NID checked, NSTB skill certificates, real work history.
auth.point_hajiri_body: QR check-in at site or one-tap marking by supervisors.
auth.point_talab_body: B.S. month wage sheets with SSF, TDS and peski handled.

onboarding.title: Set up your organization
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your business. You can add work sites, shifts and team members next.
onboarding.org_name_hint: As registered, e.g. Hotel Annapurna View Pvt. Ltd.
onboarding.pan_hint: 9-digit PAN from the Inland Revenue Department
onboarding.ward_invalid: Enter a ward number between 1 and 35
onboarding.footnote: You'll be the owner of this organization.
